baseline: Grid statistic G=sum(delta log BTC at grid * delta log ETH at grid). Previous tick is an explicit estimator transformation, never a claim of actual contemporaneous observations. No leading backfill or extrapolation beyond observed support.
completion_criteria: One qualified-input descriptive comparison with all frozen diagnostics and reproducible bytes, or a precise qualification failure. No trade plan or economic evaluation. Stop after the fixed comparison; no winner selection.
counterevidence: Equal statistics within a predeclared numerical error bound fails to support alignment sensitivity on this day; a difference supports measurement dependence only. Neither result identifies true latent covariance or proves a diversification benefit.
defer_reason: ETH price bytes absent from committed inventory; catalogue option verified, acquisition not attempted. Trade noise/chronology remain unresolved.

disclosure.scope: Authored source summaries and proposal only; no upstream paper, raw prices or private operational material.

limitations: No target covariance or economic experiment performed
Only catalogue availability verified, no ETH file bytes
Asynchronous covariance estimator not an approved economic evaluator
mechanism: Non-synchronous observation times can suppress or alter measured cross-asset co-movement; this is an observation mechanism, not evidence of diversification or lead-lag predictability.
next_action: Research role can select a one-day ETH official public trade-file acquisition through the observed catalogue, qualify file identity/time and bind hash before scanning prices. Reuse the existing BTC file; no new scheduler or route claim.
novelty: New project-level observation mechanism within existing shared-exposure seed; no scientific novelty claim.

provenance.reason: No independently visible scheduler-event attestation; automation prompt is not proof.

question: For fixed BTC and ETH trade streams over one common day, does previous-tick grid alignment change measured joint log-price variation relative to overlapping-interval accumulation?
required_data: Exact target contracts, original timestamps and price units, UTC partition and common observed support
Same-millisecond event ordering or a frozen bound; no arbitrary first/last row selection
Source coverage and RPI segment semantics recorded; no use of funding rates as price
Qualified synchronous midquotes needed before attributing differences specifically to asynchrony rather than trade-price noise
restart_condition: Initial acquisition/protocol qualification may proceed without new user approval. After a failure, retry only with corrected path/schema or new qualified evidence. After completion, only independent frozen sample, synchronized quotes or method correction can justify a new question.

sources.finding: Synchronization and interpolation can distort covariance. Equation 3.1 sums products of increments whose observation intervals overlap; its diffusion and sampling assumptions are not established for target crypto trades.
sources.title: On covariance estimation of non-synchronously observed diffusion processes
